fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-07-24 at about 13:25, it was reported that an online seller collected an advance of Rs. 96,000 for a product and then blocked the number of the complainant. Arjun Karuppasamy approached Erode Central PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000172. The account reference SYN-ACC-100054 linked to the complainant was mentioned in relation to the transactions. A further person, Udhay Muthu, a neighbour, using the number 9000000352, is stated to be associated with the incident. Venkat Palanisamy (mobile 9000000134) was named as a possible person of interest. A second person, Sathish Sundaram (9000000372), was also mentioned as possibly present. Ganesh Shankar (9000000155) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Mobile phone record; Call detail reference
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reportedly paid in advance and was blocked by the seller.
fields.Keywords: online shopping fraud, fake seller, suspect, witness, phone records, afternoon, call detail, college road
